Explore all services ↗
8 services

Cosmetic Dentistry

Dental veneers, professional teeth whitening, and treatments to enhance your smile.

Learn more ↗

Dental Implants

Dental implants and implant-supported restorations for missing teeth.

Learn more ↗

Invisalign

Clear aligner options for a straighter smile, with a plan designed around you.

Learn more ↗

Restorative Dentistry

Crowns, bridges, fillings, dentures, and partial dentures to restore your smile.

Learn more ↗

Root Canal Therapy

Treatment for damaged or infected dental pulp to help preserve natural teeth.

Learn more ↗

Preventive & General Dentistry

Examinations, professional cleanings, sealants, and everyday oral healthcare.

Learn more ↗

Gum Disease Treatment

Personalized assessment and care for gingivitis and periodontal conditions.

Learn more ↗

Night Guards & Mouthguards

Custom oral appliances for teeth grinding and protection during sports.

Learn more ↗
A practice with a personal touch

Thoughtful care.
Distinctly West Gray.

In Houston’s Montrose neighborhood, West Gray Dental brings together general, cosmetic, and restorative care in a welcoming, naturally lit space.

The practice’s approach emphasizes oral health, aesthetics, comfort, and helping you make informed decisions about your care.

  • Personalized dental treatment
  • Modern dental technology
  • A conservative, patient-focused approach
